shots.description: Japan Landing Award winners smiling with certificates (stage, Demo Day)
Attendees laughing together in the audience seats
Host smiling on stage, speaking to the room

notes: All shots slowed to 0.8x, 30 fps, 0.4 s crossfades; last shot crossfades back into the start of shot 1 for a seamless loop. Light contrast lift, saturation 0.9. Source is 1920x1080, no crop.
